proofUses.reason: The first bound applies the three-point tree-graph inequality (L82Q), the second the four-point tree shapes of the multipoint tree bound (AFH6), with mass transport and the diagram comparison IZAO for finiteness.

The derivative comes from the finite-domain Russo identity (6JBS) bounded by BK (BNY8); the boundary estimate (67GX), the weighted moment bounds (T7VI) and B<=A<=Delta^2 (IZAO) give the lower bound, and MXGM gives the lower susceptibility bound.
The proof is an explicit computation of the two-point function, susceptibility and triangle on Z and invokes no other wiki assertion.
The susceptibility and triangle bounds are proved directly by path and walk sums; the derivative bound applies the local regularity and upper derivative estimate MXGM.
